findings.one_line: The order-k_n covariance of the raw exceedance counts proves process overlap, but it does not prove a nonzero cross-covariance for the unspecified tangent scores dot_ell_{a,r}; derive that score-level cross term (or weaken the information-form conclusion).

Its inference from count-overlap to failure of the displayed I_rs repeats the upstream gap: a nonzero cross term must be shown for an actual admissible score direction, not merely for constant count test functions.

The class-level reverse proof defines the quantiles as \nu_{j,n} but immediately sets a_n=u_{1,n} and b_n=beta_n u_{2,n}; the subsequent proof uses undefined u_{j,n}, so the load-bearing quantile comparisons require a corrected, typed derivation.
